summary.text: A centaur hunter of wild boars who fled the wedding battle with Pholus, Melaneus, and Asbolus.

story.text: Ovid names Abas among the centaurs who ran for their lives when Peirithous' feast became a war — a hunter of wild boars fleeing beside Pholus and Melaneus. He is not Abas the early king of Argos (`abas`), father of Acrisius and Proetus.
